description: Agent harness for learning difficult things.

summary.one_liner: LearnHarness is a desktop learning app (TypeScript) that uses AI agents to measure what you already understand, plan a dependency map to your goal, teach step by step, and run practice sessions backed by a persistent knowledge graph.
keywords: understand a topic step by step
learn with my own api keys
summary.what_it_does: LearnHarness uses AI agents to plan and teach a lesson starting from the user's current understanding toward a stated goal. Before teaching, it probes where the user's understanding ends on each prerequisite, then builds a dependency map from that point to the goal, which the user can view and which adapts as answers come in. Teaching proceeds in steps where the user predicts, receives an explanation, and checks understanding, with confusions addressed before building on them. Separate practice sessions pose varied problems and adapt hints to the user's reasoning. Learned material is stored as propositions and reasoning chains in a persistent graph with links to source sessions, and future sessions can read that graph; users can also import notes. The README also mentions background research, visual explanations, and interactive demonstrations.
use_cases: learn a difficult subject step by step
get a personalized lesson plan from my current level
practice problems that adapt to my reasoning
keep a persistent record of what I have learned
turn my notes into a learning graph
study with my own API keys or a local model
stack: Electron-style desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux builds)
notable: Measures where your understanding ends before teaching, using answers, confidence, and written thinking
Persistent knowledge graph of propositions and reasoning chains linked to source sessions
Works with your own provider keys, subscription connections, Claude Code CLI, or a local OpenAI-compatible server
System prompts are visible and editable; local storage of chats, graph, and keys
Signed macOS DMG; Windows and Linux builds available with in-app updates
caveats: Model, dictation, and web search calls go to external services; local storage does not mean offline processing
Cost meter only estimates known API costs, not subscription, CLI, or custom-endpoint charges
Windows installer is currently unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen warnings
Dictation requires a Deepgram key with Member role or higher
